Prioritizing expensive shoes over a drowning child violates this core principle, as well as the commandments to pursue justice (*Tzedek*), act with compassion (*chesed*), and "not stand idly by the blood of your neighbor" ( Leviticus 19:16). This action is morally indefensible under Jewish law.
